recovery_target.description: Construct one or more admissible TE3-native designs (quotient coordinates plus geometric branch/representative) whose M1 flat-state hinge-participation profile d(g)=diag(P_H(g)) matches a declared target. Unique representative recovery is not claimed.

side_information: fixed VGSE graph and hinge labels
protected M1 flat-state body-hinge and projector contract
TE3 and M1 validity tests used to accept a synthesized witness
training_or_fixture_information_not_avai: the hidden quotient and branch identity used to generate a held-out target unless explicitly declared as positive-control side information
unreported alternative valid geometric representatives for the same quotient
any future fabrication or physical-response information outside the M1 flat-state model

known_transformations: change of basis within the four-dimensional hinge-rate mechanism subspace leaves P_H and d unchanged
M1 fixed-panel gauge choice leaves the labeled hinge-rate projector and d unchanged within the protected replay tolerance
by definition, any two admissible designs with the same declared d profile are observationally equivalent for the M2 target map even if their quotient or geometry differs

recoverable_object.strongest_justified_object: A set of admissible design witnesses whose hinge-participation profile matches the target within the declared observational tolerance. Injectivity of the map from quotient/branch to d is not established.

extra_information_or_normalization_for_s: explicit branch/selector identity if branch-conditioned recovery is desired
explicit quotient coordinates if quotient recovery is supplied rather than inferred
a canonical representative rule if one geometric representative must be selected
richer kinematic observations such as the full labeled projector P_H if the diagonal profile is insufficient

solver_gate.target_after_preflight: Synthesize and report one or more admissible witnesses matching d*. Preserve multiplicity. Do not report a unique quotient or geometry unless a later identifiability analysis establishes that stronger claim.
solver_gate.reason: M1 establishes same-quotient geometric branch multiplicity and branch-dependent mechanism subspaces; M2 further compresses the full mechanism projector to its diagonal, so representative-level injectivity is presently unresolved.

unresolved_assumptions: injectivity or non-injectivity of the admissible design-to-participation-profile map is not established
feasibility of arbitrary target participation profiles is not established
continuity of a chosen branch-conditioned realization map over the intended optimization neighbourhood must be tested rather than assumed
the diagonal participation profile can discard distinctions present in the full mechanism projector
